WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT ts, CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE) AS sample
  FROM {{traces}}
  WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND (service = $service)
    AND "duration_us" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE)) AND duration_us >= 0
), bounds AS (
  SELECT min(sample) AS lo, CASE WHEN max(sample) > min(sample) THEN max(sample)
    ELSE min(sample) + greatest(abs(min(sample)) * 0.01, 1) END AS hi FROM filtered
), settings AS (
  SELECT greatest(CAST($chart_bucket AS INTERVAL), INTERVAL '1 second' * greatest(1, ceil(date_diff('second', CAST($start AS TIMESTAMP), CAST($end AS TIMESTAMP)) / 200.0))) AS step
), bucketed AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(step, ts) AS ts_bucket,
    least($cf0 - 1, greatest(0, CAST(floor((sample - lo) / (hi - lo) * $cf0) AS INTEGER))) AS y_bucket,
    lo, hi, epoch(step) * 1000 AS __bucket_ms
  FROM filtered CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN settings
)
SELECT ts_bucket, y_bucket, lo + (hi - lo) * y_bucket / $cf0 AS bucket_min,
  lo + (hi - lo) * (y_bucket + 1) / $cf0 AS bucket_max, count(*) AS value, __bucket_ms
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY ts_bucket, y_bucket, lo, hi, __bucket_ms
ORDER BY ts_bucket, y_bucket
LIMIT 10000
